## Change

Describe the user-visible outcome and affected trust boundaries.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing
- [ ] Ruff formatting/lint and strict mypy pass
- [ ] Protocol schema snapshot updated or confirmed unchanged
- [ ] Security/redaction/adversarial cases considered
- [ ] ADR/docs/runbook updated when contract, state, or operations changed
- [ ] No secrets, production data, absolute paths, command output, or tokens included
- [ ] Migration and rollback compatibility reviewed
